exposure: conservative uterine surgery (hysterography, tsirulnikov triple ligation, and BHAL)
cohort: 54 women who underwent surgery for postpartum hemorrhage at the University Hospital of Cocody over a 2-year period.
finding: Postpartum hysterectomy was performed in 63% of cases and conservative uterine surgery in 37%, with no significant difference in outcomes between the two surgical approaches.
